source.evidence: Exact source revision and generated CAD exports are pinned in assets/preflight/MODEL_SOURCE_REVISION.md; geometry values are CAD-derived design dimensions, not a metrology certificate.

coordinate_frame.y_axis: airframe longitudinal; camera/front is negative Y
coordinate_frame.simulator_frame: right-handed ENU world frame; X/Y horizontal, Z up
coordinate_frame.body_forward: positive body X; CAD nose is negative Y
coordinate_frame.body_left: positive body Y; CAD positive X
coordinate_frame.spin_sign_semantics: spin_sign is the sign of body reaction torque about +body Z; rotor angular momentum uses the opposite sign
coordinate_frame.units: metres internally; source CAD parameters are millimetres

notes: Rotor locations are transformed from design coordinates using the CAD model_scale and the documented 90-degree X export rotation.

The CAD source uses a 26.45 mm design propeller radius and model_scale 1.414028; the resulting scaled diameter is approximately 74.8 mm. Existing README text contains a conflicting 63.5 mm statement; do not use that conflicting statement as a trusted dimension.
Alternating spin signs are a conventional quad-X modelling assumption and must be confirmed against the actual motor wiring/propeller rotation direction.
Mass and inertia values are deliberately null here. The legacy config/drone.json values are simulator placeholders and are not copied as aircraft facts.
